question_closure_boundary.rule: UpdateQuestionActionV2 cannot close required questions without verified evidence basis handles.
question_closure_boundary.enforcement: Pydantic restricts basis_handles to EvidenceHandle ('E\d+'); StateTransitionPolicy verifies handles resolve to valid evidence items; QUESTION_CLOSURE_BASIS_REQUIRED gate rejects ungrounded closures.

canonical_finding_promotion_boundary.rule: Hypotheses in working state cannot directly become accepted findings in investigation_findings.
canonical_finding_promotion_boundary.enforcement: Database triggers trg_investigation_finding_legal_transition, trg_investigation_finding_no_identity_update, and trg_investigation_finding_review_provenance enforce review provenance and status restrictions.

report_evidence_admission_boundary.rule: ReportEvidenceService requires valid file/cluster evidence keys. Hypotheses cannot be submitted as evidence sources.
report_evidence_admission_boundary.enforcement: ReportEvidenceService.add() verifies evidence_key via EvidenceResolver. Raw evidence direct admission by analyst is preserved.

finalization_gate_boundary.rule: FinalizationGate evaluates investigation execution closure (all delegations complete, unintegrated results resolved), decoupled from finding acceptance and report publication.
